newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle sales thin $63/live - private.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle sales thin $63/live - private.

text.p: Nebraska feedlot cattle near midday Tuesday sold at $63.00 per cwt on a live basis in thin trading, with no sales reported on a dressed basis, market sources said.
About 1,500 head sold at $63.00, down $1.00 from last week. Bids at $101.00-$102.00 per cwt/dressed were passed by owners pricing cattle at $104.00-$105.00, they said.

"There's one major packer who will call at $103.00 but no one is willing to sell below $104.00 right now," a source said. He also said weight gains had been minimally affected by heat this week as temperatures have dropped in the evenings.
